title: leptostigma setulosum
intro: Leptostigma setulosum, commonly known as Indian coleus or Coleus amboinicus, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. The health benefits of Leptostigma setulosum include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, headache, and gastrointestinal issues. Leptostigma setulosum has been found to exhibit therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Leptostigma setulosum include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
